screens.title: Route Editor
screens.description: A connected transit topology with station shapes, editable route segments, transfer points, and a compact line legend.

screens.title: Capacity Upgrade
screens.description: A station-centered choice of one capacity token with current/next values and a clear confirmation state.

screens.title: Day Results
screens.description: A network after a service interval with passenger throughput, queue pressure, and one concise next action.

limitations: All route geometry, station names, counters, and icon shapes are original; no Mini Metro screenshots, game assets, or font are included.
This is a route-map visual-language study, not a verified build-specific interface specification.
No engine integration, gameplay logic, or measured search-demand evidence is included.
